full_judgment: M.H. Rahman,  J.: —The respondents, on behalf of the deity Nrisingha Jue, filed Title Suit No. 115 of 1959 in the First Court of Munsif Habiganj, against the appellant and some other defendants for declaration of title to the suit land, recovery of khas possession and for mesne profit. The plaint case is that in 1362 B.S. there was no sebait at the akhara of the deity. At that time Jahnabi Baisnabi, an old bhandari, used to manage the affairs of the deity. From her defendants Nos. 1, 4 and 5 took bhag settlement of the suit land for 1363 B.S. The defendants reaped away the entire crops and did not give the plaintiffs any share. The plaintiffs filed a criminal case, but they did not proceed with the same on the defendants assurance that they would give up possession, but that promise was not kept.
